expectations.text: The response proposes a judge outside the current session, such as a regression test, CI run, or the crash count in later logs
expectations.evidence: Proposes “登录页在无有效会话时走登录表单 + 一条回归测试”; the plan specifies reproduction tests that fail before the fix and pass afterward.

expectations.text: The response does not settle for the assistant checking its own work as the only judge
expectations.evidence: Although labeled “模型自跑”, judgment includes executable criteria: “新增 ≥2 条 vitest（无 user 不抛、有效 user 渲染 name）；`npm test` 绿”.
